study_type_evidence.quote: Mice were injected IV with a single dose of i-body. AD-114-Im7-FH, AD-114-Im7-FH-SA21, and AD-114-PEG 30K were dosed at 3, 2 and 3 mg/kg, respectively
Jurkat cells were cultured in RPMI-1640 ... Cells were labelled with each i-body variant at a final concentration of 1 uM for 10 min at room temperature

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: Male Crl:CD1 (ICR), Charles River Canada; age not reported
in_vivo_species.quote: Mice [Male Crl:CD1 (ICR) (Charles River Canada Inc.)], rats [Sprague-Dawley Crl:CD (SD) (Charles River Canada Inc.)] and cynomolgus monkeys (Macaca fascicularis, Worldwide Primates Inc.) were housed individually

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: Sprague-Dawley Crl:CD (SD), Charles River Canada; sex and age not reported
Macaca fascicularis, Worldwide Primates Inc.; sex and age not reported
in_vivo_species.quote: cynomolgus monkeys (Macaca fascicularis, Worldwide Primates Inc.) were housed individually in a controlled environment

in_vitro_detail: Surface plasmon resonance (BIACore T200) kinetics of each i-body variant against captured human biotinylated CXCR4 lipoparticles (Integral Molecular LEV-101B) and human serum albumin (Sigma A9511); flow cytometry of CXCR4-expressing Jurkat cells labelled with 1 uM i-body and anti-His-APC secondary, analysed on a CytoflexS.

agents.name: AD-114-Im7-FH (unmodified i-body fusion)
agents.sequence: not reported in body (only the signature framework peptide LTPNQQR used for LC-MS/MS quantitation is printed)
agents.sequence_source: The full i-body sequence appears only in the PEPLIFE2 metadata header, which is not an evidence source. METHODS state 'monitoring the signature framework peptide LTPNQQR in plasma'.
agents.chemical_identifier: Molecular weight 24747 Da determined by mass spectrometry (Table 2); Im7-FH is colicin DNase immunity protein 7 fused to FLAG and His6 tags
agents.group_n: N = 3 (sparse sampling; each animal was not bled at every timepoint)
agents.group_n_quote: Error on PK values could not be determined as each animal was not bled at every timepoint.
agents.dose_route_quote: AD-114-Im7-FH, AD-114-Im7-FH-SA21, and AD-114-PEG 30K were dosed at 3, 2 and 3 mg/kg, respectively, and blood samples were collected 5 min, 2, 6, 12, 24, 72 h post dosing.
agents.pk_quote: In a murine PK study, the unmodified i-body, AD-114-Im7-FH, had a very short half-life (t1/2) of 0.18 h (11 min) (Table 1).
agents.notes_agent: Table 1 footnote a marks this mouse t1/2 as 'Data previously published by Griffiths et al. (2018) shown here for comparison to related variants.'

agents.name: AD-114-Im7-FH-SA21 (albumin-binding peptide fusion)
agents.sequence: not reported in body; the SA21 albumin-binding peptide is described only as 'an 18-mer peptide'
agents.sequence_source: RESULTS: 'SA21 is an 18-mer peptide with binding affinities for rat, rabbit and human serum albumin of 266, 320 and 467 nM, respectively.' No residue-level sequence is printed.
agents.chemical_identifier: Molecular weight 26856 Da predicted in silico (Table 2); affinity for HSA ~518 nM by SPR
agents.group_n_quote: N (number of animals) ... 3b ... bError on PK values could not be determined as each animal was not bled at every timepoint.
agents.dose_route_quote: AD-114-Im7-FH, AD-114-Im7-FH-SA21, and AD-114-PEG 30K were dosed at 3, 2 and 3 mg/kg, respectively
agents.pk_quote: The addition of SA21 correlated only with a small improvement in t1/2 to 0.95 h (57 min), whereas PEG-30K and PEG 2 x 20K significantly extended the t1/2

agents.name: AD-114-Im7-FH PEG 30K (linear 30 kDa PEG conjugate)
agents.sequence_source: Full sequence not printed in the body text.
agents.chemical_identifier: Predicted molecular weight 54747 Da (AD-114-Im7-FH + 1x PEG moiety, Table 2); 1:1 mixture of mono- and di-PEGylated species; PEG-bis-sulfone site-specific conjugation to the C-terminal His6 tag
agents.dose_route_quote: AD-114-Im7-FH, AD-114-Im7-FH-SA21, and AD-114-PEG 30K were dosed at 3, 2 and 3 mg/kg, respectively
agents.pk_quote: PEG-30K and PEG 2 x 20K significantly extended the t1/2 to 11.85 and 19.24 h, respectively (Figure 2, Table 1).

agents.name: AD-114-Im7-FH PEG 2 x 20K (branched PEG conjugate)
agents.sequence_source: Full sequence not printed in the body text.
agents.chemical_identifier: Predicted molecular weight 64747 Da (Table 2); 1:1 mixture of mono- and di-PEGylated species
agents.dose_route_quote: AD-114-PEG 2 x 20K was dosed at 1.25 mg/kg and blood samples were collected 5 min, 2, 6,12, 24, 72, 120, 144 h post dosing.
agents.pk_quote: PEG-30K and PEG 2 x 20K significantly extended the t1/2 to 11.85 and 19.24 h, respectively

agents.name: AD-114-PA600-6H (PASylated i-body with C-terminal His6)
agents.sequence: not reported in body; PA600 described only as 'the intrinsically unstructured PAS polypeptide PA600' / 'Pro/Ala-rich sequences (PASylation)'
agents.sequence_source: INTRO and RESULTS describe PA600 as a proline/alanine-rich unstructured polypeptide; no residue-level sequence is printed.
agents.chemical_identifier: Molecular weight 60661 Da by mass spectrometry (Table 2); expressed in E. coli
agents.group_n: N = 3 per route in mice (sparse sampling); N = 3 (IV) and N = 2 (SC) in cynomolgus monkeys
agents.group_n_quote: N (number of animals) ... 3b ... bError on PK values could not be determined as each animal was not bled at every timepoint.
agents.dose: 10 mg/kg in mice; 2 mg/kg in cynomolgus monkeys
agents.route: intravenous (headline), also intraperitoneal and subcutaneous in mice
agents.dose_route_quote: AD-114-PA600-6H at 10 mg/kg was administered to mice SC or IP, and blood samples were collected at 15, 30 min, 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 12,18, 24, 36, 48 and 72 h post dosing.
agents.half_life_elimination: 7.77 h (mouse IV); 7.03 h (mouse IP); 10.25 h (mouse SC)
agents.pk_quote: Analysis of AD-114-PA600 was initially extended to dosing mice at 10 mg/kg via the IP and SC routes, revealing t1/2 values of 7.03 and 10.25 h, respectively. The tmax for IP and SC routes was 2 and 8 h
agents.notes_agent: Table 1 footnote a marks the mouse IV t1/2 of 7.77 h as previously published by Griffiths et al. (2018). In cynomolgus monkeys: IV 2 mg/kg t1/2 24.27 ± 0.24 h, tmax 0.17 ± 0.29 h, Cmax 84.12 ± 22.04 ug/mL, AUClast 393 ± 69; SC 2 mg/kg t1/2 25.41 ± 5.17 h, tmax 6.00 ± 2.83 h, Cmax 5.33 ± 1.53 ug/mL, AUClast 210 ± 22.

agents.name: AD-114-PA600 (PASylated i-body without His6 tag)
agents.sequence_source: Full sequence not printed in the body text.
agents.chemical_identifier: Molecular weight 59642 Da by mass spectrometry (Table 2); expressed in E. coli
agents.group_n: N = 3 in rats (sparse sampling); N = 3 per group in the monkey dose-escalation IV and repeat-dose studies; N = 1 per SC dose-escalation regimen
agents.group_n_quote: AD-114-PA600 was administered daily to monkeys (N = 3 per group) by SC or IV injection for 7 consecutive days.
agents.dose: 3.5 mg/kg in rats; 3, 10 and 30 mg/kg IV and 0.1/1/100 or 0.3/3/10 mg/kg SC in cynomolgus monkeys; 10 and 30 mg/kg repeat dosing
agents.dose_route_quote: Rats were injected IV or SC with AD-114-PA600-6H at 3.5 mg/kg.
agents.half_life_elimination: 9.5 h (rat IV); not calculable after rat SC dosing
agents.pk_quote: In rats dosed IV with AD-114-PA600 at 3.5 mg/kg, we observed a t1/2 of 9.5 h ... When dosed SC at 3.5 mg/kg, a t1/2 value could not be calculated due to the absence of >3 time points in the terminal elimination phase, but a tmax was observed at 24 h
agents.notes_agent: No mouse data for this tag-free variant. In cynomolgus monkeys the IV t1/2 ranged from 6.69 to 24.27 h across studies; a terminal half-life of 35 h was predicted for humans by allometric scaling (a simulation, not an observation).

agents.name: negative i-body (flow cytometry control)
agents.sequence_source: Named only as 'negative i-body (shaded)' in the Figure 1 legend.
agents.group_n: not applicable (in vitro flow cytometry only)
agents.group_n_quote: Jurkat cells expressing CXCR4 were treated with AD-114 conjugates and visualized by flow cytometry: negative i-body (shaded)
agents.dose_route_quote: Cells were labelled with each i-body variant at a final concentration of 1 uM for 10 min at room temperature
agents.pk_quote: Used only as an in vitro flow cytometry negative control; no PK data reported.

concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 2 (mouse IV) and Fig. 3 (mouse IP/IV/SC and rat IV/SC)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: In vivo pharmacokinetic data from mice dosed with various half-life extended i-body conjugates via the intravenous (IV) route; showing decrease in the plasma concentration of i-body over time. N = 3
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma concentration versus time after single dosing. Fig. 4 shows the same for cynomolgus monkeys, Fig. 5 the dose-escalation profiles, Fig. 6 the repeat-dose profiles, and Fig. 7 simulated human profiles from an allometrically scaled model (simulation, not measured data).

bioanalytical_method: LC-MS/MS monitoring the signature framework peptide LTPNQQR (XBridge BEH300 C18 50 x 2.1 mm 3.5 um reverse phase column with an AB Sciex QTRAP5500 triple quadrupole); ELISA for AD-114-PA600-6H in mouse plasma using anti-human NCAM-1 capture and anti-Histidine-HRP detection
bioanalytical_quote: AD-114 variants were quantified by monitoring the signature framework peptide LTPNQQR in plasma using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS)/MS
notes: All half-lives are non-compartmental terminal elimination half-lives: Methods define 't1/2 (terminal elimination half-life); Cmax (the maximum plasma concentration), tmax (time to maximum plasma concentration)'. No absorption half-life and no rate constant (ka/ke) is reported anywhere in the body, so half_life_absorption is 'not reported' for every agent even for the IP, SC and oral-equivalent routes where an absorption phase clearly exists. The paper notes for monkey SC dosing that 'the slower absorption resulted in a lower Cmax, as expected, and a longer tmax (6 h)', which is an absorption observation but not an absorption half-life. Mouse Cmax and tmax ARE reported in Table 1 for every variant and are captured above. Table 1 footnote b states error on the rodent PK values could not be determined because each animal was not bled at every timepoint (sparse sampling), so mouse and rat values carry no SD. Footnote c explains that rat SC t1/2 was 'NC' (not calculable) for want of three terminal-phase timepoints. The full AD-114 amino-acid sequence appears only in the PEPLIFE2 metadata header, which is database metadata and not an evidence source, so every sequence field is recorded as not reported in body. The predicted human terminal half-life of 35 h is a model simulation, not measured data, and was not entered as a PK value. Plasma handling (K2-EDTA, -80 C storage in Protein LoBind tubes) is bioanalytical sample processing, not an ex vivo treatment study, so ex vivo is not listed among study_types.
